title: Bloem
description: Case notes on the Blœm flower design site — six full-viewport scenes, one rotating œ stamp and a print-plate photography budget
summary: Longform editorial engine, scroll-linked chapter typography, zero cumulative layout shift
notes: Art direction carries Isabella’s printed identity straight over — dusty rose field, pine teal lifted from the Blœm stamp and one crimson for display type, wired as three custom properties while every neutral stays warm grey

The site runs as six full-viewport scenes instead of one scroll — each collage plate drifts on its own speed between 0,3× and 0,7× scroll so the spread reads like loose photographs sliding across a table
Motion is one requestAnimationFrame loop reading a cached scroll value — zero layout reads per frame, and reduced-motion freezes the drift while every scene stays fully readable

notes.lead: Studio handover, dropped into the scenes unchanged
items: the circular œ stamp as one layered SVG
event plates at print resolution from her photographer
rose, teal and crimson chips from the Blœm stationery

notes: Plates are served at three widths and never cropped — every scene reserves its aspect box up front so the pink field holds still while the print-resolution photography decodes
EN and IT share one content model with the measure re-tuned per locale — the Italian longform runs slightly wider and both versions were hand-broken to read as one spread
Reviews ran on shared staging links with her graphic studio — two art direction rounds, comments resolved per scene and the approved plates frozen while the build moved
